# GWAS risk alleles in each haplotype's FIRE peaks

Are a haplotype's FIRE peaks enriched for the GWAS risk alleles that haplotype
carries? The FIRE paper test (`fire-figures/Rscripts/GWAS.Rmd`), run on every
HPRC Fiber-seq haplotype with its own peaks and phased genotypes. Tables come
from `scripts/fiber-gwas-genotypes.sh`.

```{r setup}
source("Rscripts/utils.R")
```

```{r params}
N_SHUFFLE <- 10
SEEDS <- 42 + seq_len(N_SHUFFLE) - 1
N_CORES <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
```

```{r load-tables}
genome <- fread("metadata/hg38.chrom.sizes", col.names = c("chrom", "size")) %>% as_tibble()
risk <- fread("Tables/fiber-gwas-risk-alleles.tsv.gz")[
    , .(Individual_ID, haplotype, chrom, start = pos - 1L, end = pos)
]
peaks <- fread("Tables/fiber-peaks-hg38.tsv.gz")[Individual_ID %in% risk$Individual_ID]
haps <- unique(peaks[, .(Individual_ID, Platform, haplotype)])
c(individuals = uniqueN(haps$Individual_ID), haplotypes = nrow(haps))
```

```{r enrichment}
count_risk <- function(windows, gw) {
    w <- windows %>%
        bed_map(gw, n_risk = n()) %>%
        replace_na(list(n_risk = 0L)) %>%
        data.table()
    w[, .(
        n_peaks = .N, bp = sum(end - start),
        risk_in_peaks = sum(n_risk), peaks_with_risk = sum(n_risk > 0)
    )]
}

enrich <- rbindlist(parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(haps)), function(i) {
    k <- haps[i]
    x <- as_tibble(peaks[k, on = .(Individual_ID, haplotype), .(chrom, start, end)])
    gw <- as_tibble(risk[k, on = .(Individual_ID, haplotype), .(chrom, start, end)])
    shuf <- bind_rows(lapply(SEEDS, function(s) bed_shuffle(x, genome, excl = x, seed = s)))
    real <- count_risk(x, gw)
    null <- count_risk(shuf, gw)
    data.table(k, real, setnames(null, paste0(names(null), "_shuffle")))
}, mc.cores = N_CORES))

enrich[, oe := (risk_in_peaks / bp) / (risk_in_peaks_shuffle / bp_shuffle)]
enrich[, p := fisher.test(matrix(c(
    peaks_with_risk, n_peaks - peaks_with_risk,
    peaks_with_risk_shuffle, n_peaks_shuffle - peaks_with_risk_shuffle
), nrow = 2))$p.value, by = .(Individual_ID, haplotype)]
fwrite(enrich, "Tables/fiber-gwas-enrichment.tsv", sep = "\t")

enrich[, .(
    haplotypes = .N,
    median_oe = median(oe), min_oe = min(oe), max_oe = max(oe),
    pooled_oe = (sum(risk_in_peaks) / sum(bp)) /
        (sum(risk_in_peaks_shuffle) / sum(bp_shuffle)),
    max_p = max(p)
)]
```

```{r enrichment-plot}
set.seed(2)
med <- median(enrich$oe)

plot <- enrich %>%
    ggplot(aes(
        x = "", y = oe,
    )) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey50") +
    geom_quasirandom(width = 0.25, alpha = 0.7, size = 0.4) +
    annotate("errorbar", x = 1, y = med, ymin = med, ymax = med, width = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text",
        x = 1, y = max(enrich$oe), label = paste0("median O/E = ", round(med, 2)),
        vjust = -0.8, size = 1.75
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        "GWAS risk alleles per bp,\nFIRE peaks / shuffled peaks",
        limits = c(0, NA),
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))
    ) +
    xlab(glue("HPRC Fiber-seq haplotypes")) +
    my_grid() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())
my_ggsave("Figures/fiber-gwas-enrichment.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1.5)
```

```{r enrichment-plot-platform}
plot_2 <- plot + aes(color = Platform) + scale_color_manual(values = PLAT_COLORS)
my_ggsave(
    "Figures/fiber-gwas-enrichment-platform.pdf",
    width = 1.5, height = 2
)
```

# Draft figure legend

**FIRE peaks are enriched for the GWAS risk alleles carried on the same
haplotype.** For each of `r nrow(enrich)` haplotypes from
`r uniqueN(enrich$Individual_ID)` HPRC individuals, the rate of GWAS risk
alleles (per kbp) carried by that haplotype within its FIRE peaks, divided by
the rate in the same peaks randomly shuffled across GRCh38 (`r N_SHUFFLE`
shuffles). Points are haplotypes, colored by sequencing platform. The black
line marks the median (O/E = `r round(med, 2)`); the dashed line marks no
enrichment.

# Draft methods

**GWAS risk allele enrichment.** We used the index SNPs and reported risk
alleles of the PICS2 GWAS Catalog (2024-09-20 release). Phased genotypes for
`r uniqueN(enrich$Individual_ID)` Fiber-seq individuals came from the HPRC
release 2 Minigraph-Cactus GRCh38 VCF (v2.0), using top-level records only. A
haplotype carried a risk allele if its allele at the index SNP position matched
the risk allele, whether reference or alternate. Risk alleles that matched
neither were compared on the opposite strand, except at A/T and C/G sites. For
each haplotype, we counted the risk alleles it carries within its own FIRE
peaks projected to GRCh38. As a null, we shuffled the same peaks
`r N_SHUFFLE` times across GRCh38 (chr1-22, X, Y and M), excluding the original
peak positions (valr `bed_shuffle`). Enrichment (O/E) is the number of risk
alleles per kbp in the real peaks divided by that in the shuffled peaks. We
tested each haplotype with a Fisher's exact test of peaks with and without a
risk allele in real versus shuffled peaks.
